top_stories.title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup Credential Abuse: 173 M365 Tenants Compromised in Trust-Through-Defaults Incident
top_stories.summary: Threat actors abused a vendor-managed credential in ConnectWise Cloud Backup to authenticate across 173 Microsoft 365 tenants in a supply chain attack. The incident highlights failures in privileged credential management, as the compromised credential resided in ConnectWise's own tenant and customer-side controls like MFA and conditional access were ineffective against the trusted vendor authentication path.

top_stories.title: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service after attackers abuse its Microsoft 365 access
top_stories.summary: ConnectWise suspended its Cloud Backup service after attackers exploited compromised application identities to gain unauthorized access to customer Microsoft 365 accounts. The incident involved a compromised credential that allowed threat actors to abuse OAuth application permissions granted to ConnectWise's platform.

top_stories.title: Passkeys Explained, and Choosing the Right Model
top_stories.summary: This article explains how WebAuthn defeats phishing and covers how to match device-bound and synced passkeys to workforce use cases using passkey profiles. It is part two of a seven-part series on migrating from MFA to passkeys in Microsoft Entra ID.

top_stories.title: SAP Cloud SDK for Python Lets Attackers Steal OAuth2 Credentials Through a Tenant Subdomain Input — CVSS 10.0
top_stories.summary: A CVSS 10.0 Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability in the SAP Cloud SDK for Python allows attackers to steal OAuth2 client credentials by manipulating the tenant_subdomain parameter without authentication. The flaw (CWE-918) enables hijacking of OAuth2 token requests, exposing application client IDs and secrets.

top_stories.title: Hackers breach Microsoft 365 tenants via ConnectWise supply-chain attack
top_stories.summary: ConnectWise shut down customer access to its Cloud Backup service after hackers exploited application identities to compromise Microsoft 365 tenants in a supply-chain attack. The breach involved attackers accessing application identities within the ConnectWise Cloud Backup platform (formerly SkyKick Cloud Backup) to gain unauthorized access to customer Microsoft 365 environments.

news.title: Why security tools lose sight of the credential
news.summary: GitGuardian published an analysis examining how credentials fall through the gaps between security tools covering code, endpoints, cloud infrastructure, identity, and secrets management. The piece addresses the challenge of tracking credential lifecycle—including whether keys are active, who owns them, and where they may be exposed across CI/CD pipelines, environment files, and collaboration platforms.

news.title: Tech Giants Block eMudhra Certificates Tied to 8 Compromised Keys
news.summary: Google, Mozilla, Apple, and other major tech organizations blocked certificates from Indian certificate authority eMudhra after discovering 8 compromised cryptographic keys. The nature of the key compromise remains unclear, but the swift action by multiple browser and platform vendors reflects the impact on PKI trust chain integrity.

news.title: Close Identity Gaps in Software Development Before Unleashing AI
news.summary: A Dark Reading roundtable examined how AI is complicating identity security within the software development lifecycle. Participants identified improved identity visibility and collaboration as key strategies for CISOs to address identity gaps introduced by AI in development workflows.

news.title: Zeabur shutting down after second security breach in two months
news.summary: Zeabur, a development platform, suffered a security breach where an attacker used leaked internal credentials stored in plaintext to compromise its infrastructure. The attacker stole over 3.2 million environment variable records and data from 321,810 accounts, marking the second breach within two months.

news.title: CJIS v6.1 Compliance: 5 Practical Priorities for Agencies
news.summary: Specops has published guidance on achieving CJIS v6.1 compliance, outlining five practical priorities for agencies. The priorities cover MFA implementation, account management, password security, logging, and audit readiness requirements under the updated standard.

news.title: Eight eMudhra CA Keys Compromised, Triggering Emergency Fixes Across Browsers and Software
news.summary: Eight eMudhra intermediate certificate authority (CA) private keys were compromised, confirmed by Mozilla and Google's Chrome Root Program on October 20. The compromised keys could allow an attacker to issue fraudulent certificates for any website that browsers would trust, prompting emergency remediation across major browsers and software.

news.title: Qilin and INC Ransomware Groups Exploit Palo Alto Networks Flaw to Bypass MFA
news.summary: Ransomware groups Qilin and INC have been exploiting CVE-2026-0257, an authentication bypass flaw in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS and Prisma Access, to circumvent MFA and establish unauthorized VPN connections. The vulnerability, rated CVSS 7.8, was patched by Palo Alto Networks in May 2026, but exploitation activity continues to be observed.

news.title: ConnectWise Resets Credentials as Cloud Backup Remains Offline After Security Incident
news.summary: ConnectWise reset accounts and replaced application credentials after a security incident resulted in unauthorized access to application identities associated with its Cloud Backup product. Remediation measures included strengthening administrative-access protections as the Cloud Backup service remained offline during the response.

news.title: AWS IAM Identity Center simplifies identity source changes from Active Directory
news.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center has updated its functionality to retain workforce identities and their assignments when changing identity sources from Active Directory to an external IdP or Identity Center directory. This change simplifies migrations between identity sources such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID without losing existing identity configurations and access assignments.

news.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
news.summary: ConnectWise disabled cloud backups after researchers identified attackers using ConnectWise credentials to authenticate into Microsoft 365 tenants. ConnectWise states customer impact remains unconfirmed while the incident raises concerns for downstream managed service providers.

news.title: GhostAction Attackers Plant Credential Stealer Disguised as Font in 94 GitHub Repositories
news.summary: The GhostAction threat actor has expanded its supply chain attack campaign by distributing credential-stealing malware disguised as a font file across 94 GitHub repositories. The attack targets open-source developers by injecting malicious GitHub Actions workflows and using phishing to deliver the stealer, which harvests credentials.

news.title: Microsoft targets the ‘agentic insider’ with new controls for rogue AI agents
news.summary: Microsoft introduced new security controls designed to limit what AI agents can do as their assessed risk level increases, targeting the emerging threat of rogue AI agents acting within enterprise environments. The controls address authorization and access scoping for agentic AI systems, extending zero trust and least-privilege principles to autonomous AI actors operating within Microsoft's security platform.

news.title: When AI becomes ‘Sally from accounts’: The new identity risk facing businesses
news.summary: The article examines the emerging identity risks posed by AI agents assigned human-like names, job titles, and personas within enterprise environments. The concern centers on how anthropomorphized AI agents may be granted excessive trust, creating authorization and access management vulnerabilities in business workflows.

news.title: Microsoft Treats AI Agents as Insiders — and the Containment Layer Just Arrived
news.summary: Microsoft announced an expansion of Project Perception on October 19, reframing how AI agents are secured by treating them as insider identities rather than external entities requiring authentication. The approach introduces a containment layer for AI agents operating within enterprise environments, with direct implications for identity governance and access management models.

news.title: Automate Active Directory joins for Elastic Beanstalk Windows applications
news.summary: AWS Elastic Beanstalk has added a feature that automatically joins Windows Server instances to an Active Directory domain at launch, prior to application deployment, eliminating the need for custom join scripts or stored domain credentials. The integration handles domain authentication natively, removing a common credential management risk in Windows workloads running on Elastic Beanstalk.

news.title: Unmasking the robots: Why it’s critical to discover AI agent identities and how Tenable helps you secure them
news.summary: Tenable has published guidance on securing AI agent identities in cloud environments, referencing Microsoft Entra Agent ID as a framework for managing agentic AI identities. The article covers discovery and security best practices for AI agent identities within Tenable One Cloud Exposure.

news.title: MiniOrange CEO Anirban Mukherji Brings Critical Cybersecurity Solutions to ASPIRE 2026
news.summary: MiniOrange CEO Anirban Mukherji is presenting cybersecurity solutions at eMazzanti Technologies' ASPIRE 2026 event, focusing on identity-first security as an alternative to password-based authentication. MiniOrange is an IAM vendor offering SSO, MFA, and related identity security products.

news.title: Agents are your newest insiders. Security must move at their speed.
news.summary: Microsoft has introduced new security capabilities in Microsoft 365 E7 and Project Perception targeting AI agent risk management. The features are designed to help organizations manage and contain insider-style risks posed by autonomous agents, with continuous adaptive protection controls.

news.title: Attackers Abuse Stolen ConnectWise Application Credentials to Target Microsoft 365
news.summary: Attackers used stolen ConnectWise application credentials to gain unauthorized access to Microsoft 365 tenants, leading ConnectWise to suspend its Cloud Backup, SaaS Security, and Cloud Management services. The incident highlights credential theft as an attack vector targeting cloud application integrations with Microsoft 365 environments.

news.title: The Agent Identity Stack Is Forming — and Enterprises Are Choosing the Perimeter Before the Measurement Layer Exists
news.summary: Enterprise security teams are rapidly implementing identity frameworks for AI agents before behavioral monitoring infrastructure exists to validate their actions. The article discusses the emerging "agent identity stack," where organizations are prioritizing identity/access controls for AI agents ahead of the observability and measurement layers needed to govern them.

news.title: IDWolf
news.summary: IDWolf is a read-only PowerShell-based auditing tool released for Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID hygiene assessment. It provides deterministic security findings, attack path analysis, compliance mapping (NIS2/ISO 27001/DORA/GDPR), and outputs results in HTML/CSV/JSONL formats with optional AI analysis.

news.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
news.summary: ConnectWise disabled seven application identities after threat actors gained unauthorized access to them and used them to compromise Microsoft 365 tenants. The incident prompted ConnectWise to suspend its Cloud Backup service while the investigation continues.

news.title: Hackers Use Compromised ConnectWise Credential to Sign In to 173 Microsoft 365 Tenants
news.summary: Threat actors used a compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup credential to gain unauthorized access to 173 Microsoft 365 tenants belonging to MSP customers. The attack highlights risks associated with federated identity and shared credentials in MSP environments, where a single compromised account can cascade across multiple customer tenants.

news.title: The Industry’s Primary Agent Identity Standard Expires in 36 Days
news.summary: The ID-JAG (Identity for JWT-based Agent Groups) draft standard for agent identity is set to expire on November 22, 2026, with 36 days remaining as of October 17. The expiration highlights a gap between commercial agentic AI infrastructure already being deployed and the pace of institutional standards development for machine/agent identity.

news.title: Mage OSS Ships an OAuth Bypass That Creates Sessions from Unrecognized Providers — the Tenth Trust-Through-Defaults Incident in Twenty-One Days
news.summary: Mage OSS has been found to contain a critical OAuth authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-111823, CVSS 9.8) that creates sessions from unrecognized identity providers, affecting all versions through 0.9.80. The flaw is categorized as a trust-through-defaults issue, representing the tenth such incident in 21 days across various platforms.

news.title: Nine Identity-Layer Bypasses in Twenty-One Days: The Trust-Through-Defaults Pattern Has Reached Every Layer of the Stack
news.summary: Nine separate identity-layer bypass vulnerabilities were disclosed across different tiers of the authentication stack within a 21-day window between late September and mid-October 2026. The vulnerabilities share a common structural flaw described as "trust-through-defaults," where receiving systems incorrectly assume assertions from trusted sources carry verified meaning.

news.title: Microsoft Is Blocking Every Third-Party Script from Its Entra Sign-In Page — and It Hits Mid-October
news.summary: Microsoft will enforce Content Security Policy (CSP) on Entra sign-in pages at login.microsoftonline.com starting mid-to-late October 2026, blocking all third-party scripts as part of its Secure Future Initiative. The change will affect organizations using custom scripts, analytics tools, or third-party integrations on their Microsoft Entra authentication pages, requiring them to audit and update their configurations before the deadline.

news.title: Six Vendors Are Shipping Agent Identity Products. The IETF Has Not Finished the Standard.
news.summary: Six vendors are shipping agent identity products despite the IETF's ID-JAG standard remaining an unfinished Internet-Draft (version -04, expiring November 22). The article identifies a standardization gap where commercial implementations are outpacing the formal specification process for agent identity.

news.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
news.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support has been actively exploited, joining a trend of edge device vulnerabilities targeting products from Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks. BeyondTrust is a PAM vendor whose Remote Support product is used by organizations for privileged remote access management.

news.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
news.summary: A high-severity zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-104935) affecting Ivanti ICS combines an authentication bypass with remote code execution, and was only partially discovered and patched in July. The incomplete patch left a window for threat actors to exploit the authentication bypass flaw in active attacks.
